title: Two of my four companions' own introduction quests were still unresolved after 591 turns and about 160 locations visited: Tamsin's 'What the Mine Took' (her mother died at Cinderhall in the Iron Downs) and Vell's 'The Exile's Ledger' (the Keepers' Hall in Hollowbrook). Both were offered within the first 35 turns of recruiting them, but their payoff sits in holds I never reached — nothing signaled up front how far down the critical path those personal threads actually live.
